About

I'm Rahat, a full-stack developer from Jashore, Bangladesh. I build business platforms end to end, from the database and APIs to the interface people use every day.

I care about two things: interfaces that feel clear and reliable, and code the next person can read and extend. That's what keeps a product healthy long after launch.
